subject: Re: Luminex MAP — security gate checklist & timeline
messages:
From: Amelia Park <amelia.park@luminex-pay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luminex Legal <legal_ops@luminex-pay.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP request + security gate questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Luminex is excited about Redwood's latency profile and routing features. Procurement and security are asking for a short, concrete MAP that captures the compliance gates we discussed so we can align internal reviewers.

Specifically can you: 
- Confirm which SOC 2 controls you consider in-scope for our deployment (data flow, logging, key management).
- Provide a SIG/CAIQ response matrix we can attach to our vendor review.
- Share the proposed DPA redline and a data retention window proposal for transaction metadata and logs.

Our target contract decision date is June 10; security wants all evidence intake done by May 28 to allow a 2-week review cycle. Can Redwood meet that acceptance window?

Would appreciate a one-sheet MAP and an initial SIG draft.

Best,
Amelia Park
Head of Integrations — Luminex Payments

--
Attachment: request-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Park <amelia.park@luminex-pay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + security gate questions

Amelia — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can support the May 28 evidence intake deadline and the June 10 contract target, provided the SIG/Q&A and SOC 2 evidence requests are scoped per the attached MAP. 

What's attached: MAP-Luminex-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners and hard dates) and a first-pass SIG-CAIQ answers draft. Highlights: 
- SOC 2: We consider CC6 (change management), CC7 (system operation) and CC3 (access controls) relevant to your deployment; we will provide the SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence index for the controls called out.
- SIG/CAIQ: Draft answers included — we flag where we will provide evidence vs. where our onboarding/process documentation provides narrative.
- DPA: We include a redline summary (high level) and propose a 90-day default transaction metadata retention window, with options for shorter retention on dedicated/private setups.

Open items we need from Luminex to lock dates: a named security reviewer, and confirmation of whether you require an HSM-backed KMS (we support customer-managed keys in Private).

If you can confirm the reviewer by EOD Thu (May 13), Ben will start the SOC 2 evidence pull and I will route the SIG items to our compliance team.

Sofia
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-Luminex-v1.xlsx, SIG-CAIQ-answers-draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Luminex MAP — evidence owners & deliverables

Team — quick coordination thread to lock owners against the MAP attached in Sofia's outbound. Key items:

1) SOC 2 evidence index (owner: Ben) — CSV folder will include: audit logs, change control tickets (last 12 months), infra network diagrams, and SOC 2 report. Target deliverable to Luminex by May 24.
2) SIG/CAIQ definitive answers (owner: Neha) — flag items that require product sign-off; deliver draft by May 18.
3) DPA redline and retention appendix (owner: Sean) — I'll review legal redline; Sean to confirm retention options for hosted vs dedicated and call out encryption/KMS approach. Deliver to Amelia by May 16.
4) Evidence intake window: we commit to May 24–28 for the intake run (files + secure share). Need confirmation of Luminex reviewer to give them access.

Neha/Sean: can you confirm you can hit the dates above? If we need to push to a later intake window we should signal asap so Amelia can adjust.

Ben
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 10:02 Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Amelia — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can support...

From: Amelia Park <amelia.park@luminex-pay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luminex Legal <legal_ops@luminex-pay.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Luminex MAP — security gate checklist & timeline

Sofia / team — thanks for the detailed MAP and the draft SIG answers. We've reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and propose the following updates before we mark the intake window: 
- Please move the SOC 2 evidence delivery to May 26 (one day later) — our security lead has another review on May 24.
- DPA redline: Legal submitted a few clarifying asks (see attached DPA-redline-notes.pdf) — can Redwood confirm acceptance/non-acceptance of clause 5.2 and proposed edits to data deletion SLA?
- Retention: Luminex will take the 90-day default for transaction metadata in hosted, but requests a 30-day encrypted-log retention for the aggregated logs used in fraud detection. Is that supported?

If Redwood can confirm SOC 2 delivery on May 26 and respond to the two DPA redline items by May 21, we can keep the overall contract decision target of June 10. Thanks — Amelia

--
